verdict.rationale: Xero's own app marketplace lists the Q2X migration service, which handles QuickBooks-to-Xero migration 'from start to finish' and ensures 'a smooth transition of your historical data'; Xero covers the cost of simple conversions, so this is a Xero-sponsored migration path rather than a user-side workaround. It is still a specialist-run service, not an in-product import tool, and it only covers QuickBooks. Missing for 10: evidence that transaction-level detail is preserved, support for source systems other than QuickBooks, a first-party self-serve migration or import tool, and what non-simple conversions involve or cost.

support.subject: As a founder, I can migrate historical books from another accounting system without losing transaction detail

citations.quote: Our specialists will help set up a Xero account and handle the migration from start to finish, ensuring a smooth transition of your historical data. Xero generously covers the cost of simple conversions.
The Q2X team ensures a seamless transition from QuickBooks to Xero.
